page.layout: One printed page, no text of its own. The visible lines are show-through from the title page on the reverse, mirrored and faint. A handwritten "0." stands at the top left corner.
page.notes: Blank page apart from show-through. The mirrored title-page text (a dissertation title, author name, Latin lines, imprint and date at the foot) belongs to the reverse side and is not transcribed. The handwritten "0." at top left is not printed and is left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
